2026-10-11 14:41:22.798159 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-11 14:41:22.798169 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-11 14:41:22.798183 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
